file_path.field: path of the file entry in the listing that holds the baby shower invitee list

draft_id.field: draft_id of the draft that is the baby shower invitation template

calls.pddl: (gmail-send-email email-invitee-1 subject-baby-shower-invitation body-invitee-1 gmail-token invitee-1 file-baby-shower-invitees draft-baby-shower-template)

email_addresses.field: content -> email address of invitee 1 (passed as single-element list) [item 1 of 7 that match this rule; one object per matching item]

body.field: body with {curly-brace} placeholders replaced by invitee 1's details from the invitee file [item 1 of 7 that match this rule; one object per matching item]
